name: The Amorphous Flute-Player
summary: A shapeless, flute-piping entity that provides the music for the underground Yule-rite beneath Kingsport, its change of key triggering an unspeakable horror.
description:
An amorphous shape squatted in the darkness beyond the ring of cold flame during the underground Yule-rite beneath Kingsport, piping noisomely on a flute whose noxious muffled flutterings answered from the fetid dark where nothing could be clearly seen.

At a signal from the old man who led the rite, the thing shifted its feeble drone into another key, precipitating a horror unthinkable and unexpected that transfixed the narrator with a dread not of this world. By the time the narrator staggered back to his feet, the amorphous flute-player had rolled out of sight, leaving only two of its patient winged beasts standing by.

sources.quote: I saw something amorphously squatted far away from the light, piping noisomely on a flute; and as the thing piped I thought I heard noxious muffled flutterings in the fetid darkness where I could not see.

the old man made a signal to the half-seen flute-player in the darkness, which player thereupon changed its feeble drone to a scarce louder drone in another key; precipitating as it did so a horror unthinkable and unexpected
